policy.scope: Publicly discoverable AI agents, MCP servers and agent platforms
policy.verification: A listing is published only when an official homepage, repository or protocol page is attached; discovery signals are never treated as product claims.
policy.url_checks: source_checked / repo_checked are the dates each URL last answered 2xx/3xx to scripts/agent-watch-verify.mjs (daily, on the CI runner) or to a maintaining session. null = not yet reached from a network that can fetch it; a listing never claims a check it did not make.
